title: Malformed X-Renbans
author: Jorava
rules:
Normal renbans, but you need to figure out how each line goes.

Solve in Sudokupad

---

The idea for this puzzle was inspired by a comment on an earlier puzzle of mine, which had branching renban lines, and a solver thought they were separate lines. That perspective never occurred to me until someone said it. This proves the value of feedback. It allows a setter to make better puzzles, improve the wording of the rules, and sometimes come up with new ideas for puzzles.

---

Rules:

Normal sudoku rules apply. Place the digits 1-9 in every row, column, and 3x3 box without repetition.

Renban:
Digits on a single purple line must be a consecutive set without repeats, but can be in any order.

Special:
In this puzzle, each renban line shares exactly one cell with a different line. The 2 lines may cross each other or simply make a turn in the same cell. None of the lines branch or end in an intersection.
